note: Both sets are dominated by vague entities ('component', 'dimension') that bind real dimension strings to unspecified parts, but Set A includes at least one clearly verifiable and correctly bound claim (Drawing C1 scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0") and correctly ties 3'-1 5/16" and 2'-11 7/8" to the rightmost segments of the Module B and Module A details. Set B misassigns 2'-3 7/8" to Module B when it appears in the Module A detail, truncates 2'-3 7/8" to '2'-3', and invents 'flange width (left/right) 1 1/2"' bindings not supported by the sheet. Set A also has clear errors (4 13" misread of 4 13/16", truncated 2'-3, invented base-block hole offsets and base-plate thickness), so the margin is modest.
